mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a brisk 26 degrees under clear skies at the Verona Area High School, with a waxing crescent moon visible overhead.
The City of Verona has several election notices posted for the 2026 cycles, and the Plan Commission is reviewing new site plans for the Sub-Zero project in the Liberty Business Park.

We have a full calendar, starting today with the Dane County Farmer's Market and live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's, followed by the John Denver tribute tomorrow at the High School Fine Arts Center.
In a report regarding noteworthy calls, on October 25th, Verona police arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I offence after finding him unresponsive in his vehicle at an intersection.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. The store is currently closed but will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
